author: NIN Creative Studio
title: Hiring Illustrator Artists for Characters, Creatures, Environments
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: Baltic Analog Lab
title: Looking for illustrator for new merch artwork
content: We’re looking for a freelance graphic designer (preferably based in Latvia) for occasional collaborations, as well as an illustrator (national or international) to create fun artwork for our new merch! 🦄 Send us a DM with your Instagram account or website. And if you know someone whose work you love, share your recommendations with us! ✨

author: Malaka Books
title: Open call for book designers & illustrators
content: FOR BOOK DESIGNERS & ILLUSTRATORS 🗣️ Malaka Books bakal menerbitkan beberapa buku baru. Nah, buat kamu para illustrator dan designer, kami lagi ngebuka kesempatan kolaborasi untuk terlibat langsung dalam proses penerbitan buku cetak. Tidak ada deadline ya, silahkan mendaftar jika tertarik, akan kami cek berkala. Tertarik buat gabung? Langsung isi formulir di sini ya 👇 🔗 bit.ly/talentmalakabooks #MalakaBooks #TalentMalakaBooks Contact: bit.ly/talentmalakabooks
